title: INSEAD Thrive Lab lists later dates for award and fellowship details
summary: INSEAD Thrive Lab’s opportunity map separates December and January information releases from a September 2027 fellowship start and a July 2027 London research meeting.
body_markdown:
##


Application and registration details remain incomplete


An information‑release month is not a submission deadline. The page does not yet provide a complete award application or meeting‑registration process.


For prospective research preparation, OpenTools’[academic‑research‑skills guide](https://opentools.ai/resources/academic-research-skills) distinguishes assisted planning, literature review and writing from the researcher’s responsibility for the question, method and interpretation. It is general preparation context, not Thrive’s application requirements or an endorsement by the lab.


AI‑generated conceptual illustration of research‑proposal preparation beside a closed planner. It does not depict Thrive Lab, actual application materials or the lab’s dates. Original artwork by OpenTools Team.
